action_items: No blocking fixes required. All requested checks pass; the wizard submits successfully to the LIVE backend and returns a real reference (F3807324) rendered on the success screen.

OPTIONAL polish (edge case only): in /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx the contact state is initialized via useState from user (const [contact, setContact] = useState({ name: user?.full_name || '', email: user?.email || '' })). If the wizard is opened via a DIRECT navigation (page.goto /quote/new) before the auth context has finished loading /me, both fields stay empty because useState only runs its initializer once. The normal entry path (tap lower-bills-cta on the dashboard) does not hit this because user is already loaded — email prefill is confirmed working via that flow. Add a useEffect that syncs contact when user first becomes available, or gate the wizard behind !!user, if strict prefill on deep-link is required.
critical_code_review_comments: quote/new.tsx: contact prefill is done once in useState initializer. Consider a useEffect to sync when useAuth().user resolves asynchronously — see action_items #2.
